purpose: Teach: プロレタリアート/ユニバーサル/中日/ヘクタール/コンプレックス/アンチ/電脳/乙女

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、プロレタリアート文学の戦後史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote your paper on the postwar history of proletarian literature, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Genuine interest — not testing, genuinely recalling. Steady eye contact. The pause before her name makes it personal, not clinical.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ユニバーサルデザインの普及を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I wrote mine on the adoption of universal design principles.
lines.style: Precise, slightly correcting but not defensive. Direct gaze. A hint of self-awareness — she knows the mismatch is odd but she's committed to what she actually did.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 中日関係の外交史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ah — and for that one you focused on Sino-Japanese diplomatic history?
lines.style: Recalibrating gently. A slight knowing smile underneath. Not caught off-guard, but noticing the pattern. Warm curiosity, not suspicion.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、農地のヘクタール換算法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I looked at hectare conversion methods in agricultural land measurement.
lines.style: Each correction lands quietly. No apology, no edge. She's patient with the misunderstanding. Matter-of-fact delivery, like she's used to explaining herself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 現代人のコンプレックス研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see. So when you studied modern psychological complexity...?
lines.style: Leaning in slightly, genuinely puzzled now. Warm but more direct. A teacher beginning to understand something unexpected. Slight tilt of the head.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、アンチエイジング医学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: That was actually on anti-aging medicine and its medical applications.
lines.style: No hesitation. Clear and steady. There's an almost wry acceptance in her tone — like she knows how this sounds but she's telling the truth anyway. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: サイバー空間の電脳社会論を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the cyber-society theory paper — that was about...?
lines.style: Softer now. Less assuming. Leaning back slightly, giving space. Genuine puzzle-solving with her. The rhythm is slower, more collaborative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代日本文学の乙女像を論文で扱いました
lines.en: The image of maidens in modern Japanese literature.
lines.style: Final answer, delivered with quiet completion. A slight breath before speaking — she knows how far from expectation she is. Calm and unshaken. Small relief at having said it all.
